_comment: Unit 9's batch of voice edits. Same rules as voice_curate.json.
Unit 9 has no lecture deck either, and the notes say so twice - once in a callout
addressed to whoever maintains the site, and once as a 'where it comes from in
the course' column in the Docker table, whose cells open with 'The deck's'. The
callout goes; the table cells keep the cross-reference and lose the attribution.
Those four are written out in full because the phrase to drop and the bolded term
beside it are separated by markup, which a prose entry cannot span.

edits.why: the callout is a note to whoever maintains the site - no lecture deck was shared, what this page was assembled from, upload one and the page gets rewritten - and none of it is about edge computing; written out in full because a deletion may span markup and this one has to take the box with it
edits.find:
About this unit's sources

There is no Chapter 9 lecture deck among the shared files. This page is written from the Chapter 6 deck's container material (which is what 9.3 and 9.4 build on), from Tanenbaum and Van Steen's discussion of edge and fog computing, from the Chapter 7 material on Lambda and managed Kubernetes, and from the syllabus list itself. Definitions of industry terms are given as such. If a Chapter 9 deck exists, upload it and this page can be rewritten from class material.
